==> meridian/text.py <==
     1	"""Text helpers shared by the ingest readers."""
     2	
     3	
     4	def clean_number(raw):
     5	    """Turn a v1 amount into a plain decimal string ("1.234,56" -> "1234.56")."""
     6	    return raw.strip().replace(" ", "").replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
     7	
     8	
     9	def plain_number(raw):
    10	    """Turn a v2 amount into a plain decimal string ("1,425.01" -> "1425.01")."""
    11	    return raw.strip().replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")
    12	
    13	
    14	# The amount convention each export format uses, keyed by its "# format:" name.
    15	# v1 groups thousands with dots or spaces and ends with a decimal comma; v2
    16	# writes a plain decimal point and groups with commas.
    17	FORMATS = {"v1": clean_number, "v2": plain_number}
    18	
    19	
    20	def declared_format(lines, path):
    21	    """Name the amount convention an export declares in its "# format:" header."""
    22	    for line in lines:
    23	        if line.startswith("# format:"):
    24	            name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
    25	            if name not in FORMATS:
    26	                raise ValueError("%s: unsupported export format %r" % (path, name))
    27	            return name
    28	    raise ValueError("%s: export declares no '# format:' header" % path)
    29	
    30	
    31	def squash(s):
    32	    """Collapse runs of whitespace."""
    33	    return " ".join(s.split())
